meta.title: A Star Is Born
meta.description: A shining star streaks across the heavens and falls to the earth.

units.rawText: Those who visit violence upon others shall have violence visited upon themselves, until they change their ways.
units.displayText: Those who visit violence upon others shall have violence visited upon themselves, until they change their ways.

spans.text: Those who visit violence upon others shall have violence visited upon themselves, until they change their ways.

units.rawText: Similarly, this punishment is meant to encourage you to change your ways and console the innocent. May the Lord grant your soul mercy in equal proportion to the corporal mortification that I am about to visit upon thee...
units.displayText: Similarly, this punishment is meant to encourage you to change your ways and console the innocent. May the Lord grant your soul mercy in equal proportion to the corporal mortification that I am about to visit upon thee...

units.rawText: No, don't—please, spare me! I was just helping out! I'll talk! I'll tell you everything!
units.displayText: No, don't—please, spare me! I was just helping out! I'll talk! I'll tell you everything!

spans.text: No, don't—please, spare me! I was just helping out! I'll talk! I'll tell you everything!

units.rawText: I'll tell you about that girl, about where she is! See, just over there—
units.displayText: I'll tell you about that girl, about where she is! See, just over there—

spans.text: I'll tell you about that girl, about where she is! See, just over there—

units.rawText: Bang!
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: You were planning to ambush me while I was distracted? Such a pitiful display of trickery, and a feeble effort of physical violence.
units.displayText: You were planning to ambush me while I was distracted? Such a pitiful display of trickery, and a feeble effort of physical violence.

spans.text: You were planning to ambush me while I was distracted? Such a pitiful display of trickery, and a feeble effort of physical violence.

units.rawText: It is clear that your sins have not yet been cleansed, and sincere repentance is in order.
units.displayText: It is clear that your sins have not yet been cleansed, and sincere repentance is in order.

spans.text: It is clear that your sins have not yet been cleansed, and sincere repentance is in order.

units.rawText: <size=40>No, DOOOOOON'T!</size>
units.displayText: No, DOOOOOON'T!

spans.text: No, DOOOOOON'T!

units.rawText: I will teach you this little lesson on the Lord's behalf.
units.displayText: I will teach you this little lesson on the Lord's behalf.

units.rawText: <color=red>And I will find her whereabouts on my own.</color>

units.rawText: So it's memory data from the past again, huh... Looks like only by cleansing my sins will I be able to—Hm?

units.rawText: This is...
units.displayText: This is...

spans.text: This is...

units.rawText: What are you looking for? Your guns, perhaps?
units.displayText: What are you looking for? Your guns, perhaps?

spans.text: What are you looking for? Your guns, perhaps?

units.rawText: Professor? What are you doing here?
units.displayText: Professor? What are you doing here?

spans.text: Professor? What are you doing here?

units.rawText: After a brief period of surprise, Erika immediately sits up straight and her face returns to its usual expression.
units.displayText: After a brief period of surprise, Erika immediately sits up straight and her face returns to its usual expression.

spans.text: After a brief period of surprise, Erika immediately sits up straight and her face returns to its usual expression.

units.rawText: Do you wish to seek me for confession? I am willing to listen to the troubles of others and to grant them solace.
units.displayText: Do you wish to seek me for confession? I am willing to listen to the troubles of others and to grant them solace.

spans.text: Do you wish to seek me for confession? I am willing to listen to the troubles of others and to grant them solace.

units.rawText: You may unburden yourself of any sin you wish to confess to, whether it is the confiscation of my personal property or some other secret.
units.displayText: You may unburden yourself of any sin you wish to confess to, whether it is the confiscation of my personal property or some other secret.

spans.text: You may unburden yourself of any sin you wish to confess to, whether it is the confiscation of my personal property or some other secret.

units.rawText: Ahem. Sorry for doing that without getting your permission first. We were just undergoing some routine examinations.
units.displayText: Ahem. Sorry for doing that without getting your permission first. We were just undergoing some routine examinations.

spans.text: Ahem. Sorry for doing that without getting your permission first. We were just undergoing some routine examinations.

units.rawText: If the examinations turn out fine, I will return everything we have taken from you, just as I will do so now. In truth, that is one of the reasons why I was looking for you.
units.displayText: If the examinations turn out fine, I will return everything we have taken from you, just as I will do so now. In truth, that is one of the reasons why I was looking for you.

spans.text: If the examinations turn out fine, I will return everything we have taken from you, just as I will do so now. In truth, that is one of the reasons why I was looking for you.

units.rawText: I hand the bag to Erika. She nods and begins going through the contents.
units.displayText: I hand the bag to Erika. She nods and begins going through the contents.

spans.text: I hand the bag to Erika. She nods and begins going through the contents.

units.rawText: There are three guns missing.
units.displayText: There are three guns missing.

spans.text: There are three guns missing.

units.rawText: They were sawed off and don't conform to the general-use regulations, which means they're potentially hazardous items that require further inspection.
units.displayText: They were sawed off and don't conform to the general-use regulations, which means they're potentially hazardous items that require further inspection.

spans.text: They were sawed off and don't conform to the general-use regulations, which means they're potentially hazardous items that require further inspection.

units.rawText: Some of your weapons were damaged. The Security Department has helped to repair them. Oh yes, these are your religious texts.
units.displayText: Some of your weapons were damaged. The Security Department has helped to repair them. Oh yes, these are your religious texts.

spans.text: Some of your weapons were damaged. The Security Department has helped to repair them. Oh yes, these are your religious texts.

units.rawText: ...It seems you've taken very good care of them. However, there was no need to go out of your way to take them out. You could have put them into my luggage with my manga.
units.displayText: ...It seems you've taken very good care of them. However, there was no need to go out of your way to take them out. You could have put them into my luggage with my manga.

units.rawText: That would be correct if we were only going by their physical properties, but that might not be the case from another point of view.
units.displayText: That would be correct if we were only going by their physical properties, but that might not be the case from another point of view.

spans.text: That would be correct if we were only going by their physical properties, but that might not be the case from another point of view.

units.rawText: ...You want me to continue being a counsellor?
units.displayText: ...You want me to continue being a counsellor?

spans.text: ...You want me to continue being a counsellor?

units.rawText: That would be up to you. In the Oasis, every Doll can choose to pursue their own interests and work that utilizes their strengths.
units.displayText: That would be up to you. In the Oasis, every Doll can choose to pursue their own interests and work that utilizes their strengths.

spans.text: That would be up to you. In the Oasis, every Doll can choose to pursue their own interests and work that utilizes their strengths.

units.rawText: We have two possible vocational niches for you. Picking one, or the other—or neither, for that matter—is perfectly fine.
units.displayText: We have two possible vocational niches for you. Picking one, or the other—or neither, for that matter—is perfectly fine.

spans.text: We have two possible vocational niches for you. Picking one, or the other—or neither, for that matter—is perfectly fine.

units.rawText: Erika looks at the guns and the religious texts in front of her and falls silent for a moment.
units.displayText: Erika looks at the guns and the religious texts in front of her and falls silent for a moment.

spans.text: Erika looks at the guns and the religious texts in front of her and falls silent for a moment.

units.rawText: As it just so happens, the Oasis is building a chapel. Everyone needs a space to remember the past and seek guidance for themselves.
units.displayText: As it just so happens, the Oasis is building a chapel. Everyone needs a space to remember the past and seek guidance for themselves.

spans.text: As it just so happens, the Oasis is building a chapel. Everyone needs a space to remember the past and seek guidance for themselves.

units.rawText: I'm sure that as a counsellor yourself, you're more familiar with this sort of thing and better at handling such situations than me, so I figured asking you would be a good idea.
units.displayText: I'm sure that as a counsellor yourself, you're more familiar with this sort of thing and better at handling such situations than me, so I figured asking you would be a good idea.

spans.text: I'm sure that as a counsellor yourself, you're more familiar with this sort of thing and better at handling such situations than me, so I figured asking you would be a good idea.

units.rawText: A chapel... No, I'm not familiar with such a place. Tell me about the other option.
units.displayText: A chapel... No, I'm not familiar with such a place. Tell me about the other option.

spans.text: A chapel... No, I'm not familiar with such a place. Tell me about the other option.

units.rawText: The gun represents field expeditions, with the presumable possibility of violence. How about it? If you need more time to consider, I can come back at a later time.
units.displayText: The gun represents field expeditions, with the presumable possibility of violence. How about it? If you need more time to consider, I can come back at a later time.

spans.text: The gun represents field expeditions, with the presumable possibility of violence. How about it? If you need more time to consider, I can come back at a later time.

units.rawText: Currently, the Oasis has a few fieldwork openings that require people to fight against enemies from outside the sector.
units.displayText: Currently, the Oasis has a few fieldwork openings that require people to fight against enemies from outside the sector.

spans.text: Currently, the Oasis has a few fieldwork openings that require people to fight against enemies from outside the sector.

units.rawText: This is most fortuitous. It suits me well, as well as the guns I favor. I'll take it.
units.displayText: This is most fortuitous. It suits me well, as well as the guns I favor. I'll take it.

spans.text: This is most fortuitous. It suits me well, as well as the guns I favor. I'll take it.

units.rawText: Don't you want to hear about the other one? The other job involves working with the logistics department to build a chapel, and we'd be delighted to have help from a counsellor like yourself.
units.displayText: Don't you want to hear about the other one? The other job involves working with the logistics department to build a chapel, and we'd be delighted to have help from a counsellor like yourself.

spans.text: Don't you want to hear about the other one? The other job involves working with the logistics department to build a chapel, and we'd be delighted to have help from a counsellor like yourself.

units.rawText: Do you want to think more about it?
units.displayText: Do you want to think more about it?

spans.text: Do you want to think more about it?

units.rawText: I understand your intentions, Professor, but there is no need for me to think further on the matter. I'm happy with what this gun represents, and fieldwork sounds pretty good too.
units.displayText: I understand your intentions, Professor, but there is no need for me to think further on the matter. I'm happy with what this gun represents, and fieldwork sounds pretty good too.

spans.text: I understand your intentions, Professor, but there is no need for me to think further on the matter. I'm happy with what this gun represents, and fieldwork sounds pretty good too.

units.rawText: Mind telling me why you chose to do fieldwork?
units.displayText: Mind telling me why you chose to do fieldwork?

spans.text: Mind telling me why you chose to do fieldwork?

units.rawText: So you want to know my reasons... I've been working in prisons until recently. I'm used to taking confessions and clearing corpses.
units.displayText: So you want to know my reasons... I've been working in prisons until recently. I'm used to taking confessions and clearing corpses.

spans.text: So you want to know my reasons... I've been working in prisons until recently. I'm used to taking confessions and clearing corpses.

units.rawText: It's either criminals or corruption there. Not much else to speak of. Life in a closed-off environment is boring, and if possible, I think working in the field would be a welcome change of pace for me.
units.displayText: It's either criminals or corruption there. Not much else to speak of. Life in a closed-off environment is boring, and if possible, I think working in the field would be a welcome change of pace for me.

spans.text: It's either criminals or corruption there. Not much else to speak of. Life in a closed-off environment is boring, and if possible, I think working in the field would be a welcome change of pace for me.

units.rawText: I see. However, our fieldwork might involve dangerous situations that might be tougher than the battles you've had in the past.
units.displayText: I see. However, our fieldwork might involve dangerous situations that might be tougher than the battles you've had in the past.

spans.text: I see. However, our fieldwork might involve dangerous situations that might be tougher than the battles you've had in the past.

units.rawText: So they'll be dangerous? That's even less of a concern to me; I don't fear danger. My curriculum vitae should have told you as such. Scourging the unrepentant is my stock in trade. It is my reason for existence.
units.displayText: So they'll be dangerous? That's even less of a concern to me; I don't fear danger. My curriculum vitae should have told you as such. Scourging the unrepentant is my stock in trade. It is my reason for existence.

spans.text: So they'll be dangerous? That's even less of a concern to me; I don't fear danger. My curriculum vitae should have told you as such. Scourging the unrepentant is my stock in trade. It is my reason for existence.

units.rawText: Since it's all matters regarding cleansing sin, then it's all the same no matter where I go to do it. What dangers can't be found in a prison? I'm used to them.
units.displayText: Since it's all matters regarding cleansing sin, then it's all the same no matter where I go to do it. What dangers can't be found in a prison? I'm used to them.

spans.text: Since it's all matters regarding cleansing sin, then it's all the same no matter where I go to do it. What dangers can't be found in a prison? I'm used to them.

units.rawText: Then your wounds...
units.displayText: Then your wounds...

spans.text: Then your wounds...

units.rawText: I am also used to them.
units.displayText: I am also used to them.

spans.text: I am also used to them.

units.rawText: <size=28>Although, I'm not sure who helped me bind them this time.</size>
units.displayText: Although, I'm not sure who helped me bind them this time.

spans.text: Although, I'm not sure who helped me bind them this time.

units.rawText: Erika unconsciously touches her injuries under her robes that someone has treated for her. There is a neatly-tied bandage under her fingers, but the wound below it does not hurt.
units.displayText: Erika unconsciously touches her injuries under her robes that someone has treated for her. There is a neatly-tied bandage under her fingers, but the wound below it does not hurt.

spans.text: Erika unconsciously touches her injuries under her robes that someone has treated for her. There is a neatly-tied bandage under her fingers, but the wound below it does not hurt.

units.rawText: I've been hurt worse than this before too. This sort of thing happens eventually in my line of work, so it's no big deal.
units.displayText: I've been hurt worse than this before too. This sort of thing happens eventually in my line of work, so it's no big deal.

spans.text: I've been hurt worse than this before too. This sort of thing happens eventually in my line of work, so it's no big deal.

units.rawText: What about the chapel? Hearing confessions is part of being a counsellor too, and I would hazard a guess that a chapel would be in line with your vocation.
units.displayText: What about the chapel? Hearing confessions is part of being a counsellor too, and I would hazard a guess that a chapel would be in line with your vocation.

spans.text: What about the chapel? Hearing confessions is part of being a counsellor too, and I would hazard a guess that a chapel would be in line with your vocation.

units.rawText: Indeed, I am a counsellor, but I am also a counsellor that was specifically tailored for prison environments. From the moment I was rolled out until just before I arrived in the cloud server, most of my life was spent in prison.
units.displayText: Indeed, I am a counsellor, but I am also a counsellor that was specifically tailored for prison environments. From the moment I was rolled out until just before I arrived in the cloud server, most of my life was spent in prison.

spans.text: Indeed, I am a counsellor, but I am also a counsellor that was specifically tailored for prison environments. From the moment I was rolled out until just before I arrived in the cloud server, most of my life was spent in prison.

units.rawText: I've never been to a proper chapel before and I have no recollection of such things, so I must apologize if I cannot give you any suggestions regarding the construction of a chapel. Besides, violence is a close friend of mine and I wouldn't be welcome in such a place.
units.displayText: I've never been to a proper chapel before and I have no recollection of such things, so I must apologize if I cannot give you any suggestions regarding the construction of a chapel. Besides, violence is a close friend of mine and I wouldn't be welcome in such a place.

spans.text: I've never been to a proper chapel before and I have no recollection of such things, so I must apologize if I cannot give you any suggestions regarding the construction of a chapel. Besides, violence is a close friend of mine and I wouldn't be welcome in such a place.

units.rawText: Well, you don't have to be in such a hurry to count yourself out. Your past doesn't define your future, after all. Perhaps, trying something new might be good for you.
units.displayText: Well, you don't have to be in such a hurry to count yourself out. Your past doesn't define your future, after all. Perhaps, trying something new might be good for you.

spans.text: Well, you don't have to be in such a hurry to count yourself out. Your past doesn't define your future, after all. Perhaps, trying something new might be good for you.

units.rawText: No... the past is past, but the scars it leaves behind will not fade. "From the fruit of their lips people are filled with good things, and the work of their hands brings them reward."
units.displayText: No... the past is past, but the scars it leaves behind will not fade. "From the fruit of their lips people are filled with good things, and the work of their hands brings them reward."

spans.text: No... the past is past, but the scars it leaves behind will not fade. "From the fruit of their lips people are filled with good things, and the work of their hands brings them reward."

units.rawText: Indeed, as it says within your texts.
units.displayText: Indeed, as it says within your texts.

spans.text: Indeed, as it says within your texts.

units.rawText: However, I'm sure you remember that it also says, "And where these have been forgiven, sacrifice for sin is no longer necessary."
units.displayText: However, I'm sure you remember that it also says, "And where these have been forgiven, sacrifice for sin is no longer necessary."

spans.text: However, I'm sure you remember that it also says, "And where these have been forgiven, sacrifice for sin is no longer necessary."

units.displayText: Erika's eyes widen a little as she hears this.

units.rawText: I didn't think you were so well read, Professor...
units.displayText: I didn't think you were so well read, Professor...

spans.text: I didn't think you were so well read, Professor...

units.rawText: I'm surely just a dabbler in comparison to you.
units.displayText: I'm surely just a dabbler in comparison to you.

spans.text: I'm surely just a dabbler in comparison to you.

units.rawText: But even if sin is forgiven, that doesn't mean it doesn't exist.
units.displayText: But even if sin is forgiven, that doesn't mean it doesn't exist.

spans.text: But even if sin is forgiven, that doesn't mean it doesn't exist.

units.rawText: Thank you for your concern, Professor, but I've already made my choice regarding my work arrangements.
units.displayText: Thank you for your concern, Professor, but I've already made my choice regarding my work arrangements.

spans.text: Thank you for your concern, Professor, but I've already made my choice regarding my work arrangements.

units.rawText: (Sigh) Alright, then. If that is your answer, then I will respect it.
units.displayText: (Sigh) Alright, then. If that is your answer, then I will respect it.

spans.text: (Sigh) Alright, then. If that is your answer, then I will respect it.

units.rawText: You'll need to go to the Fieldwork Department to get field assignments. Head outside and turn left, go down two streets and report to the Fieldwork Department Office on the outskirts of the Oasis. After that, you can look for either Aki of Team E01 or Abigail of Team E02.

units.rawText: They'll arrange for appropriate assignments for you, which might be a little challenging or dangerous from time to time. All the best.
